newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ABS-CBN 1997 first qtr net 248 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: ABS-CBN 1997 first qtr net 248 mln pesos.

text.p: The Philippines leading television and radio broadcaster ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp on Wednesday reported a drop in its first quarter net income to 248 million pesos.
The figure was down from a net of 288 million pesos reported last year.
ABS-CBN president Eugenio Lopez III, who gave the net profit figure to reporters after the company's stockholders meeting, said revenues were affected by a row they had with advertisers.
Last month, a group of advertisers decided to cancel their advertisements to ABS-CBN after it raised prime time rates.
The advertisers group said the hike was too steep and wanted it to be cut.
The advertisements were resumed after the two sides reached a compromise.
